mapper.select: /* top tab AND A.IMEX_HIS_CD = '01' */ SELECT B.* , CASE WHEN NVL(( SELECT MIN(C.IMEX_HIS_CD) /* 수출입명세코드 */ FROM CSPD002TG C /* 테스크테이블 */ WHERE C.INPT_MST_SRNO = B.INPT_MST_SRNO /* 심사마스터일련번호 */ AND C.IMEX_HIS_CD = '01' ), ' ') = ' ' THEN 'BL(X)' /* 수출입명세코드 */ ELSE 'BL' || B.INPT_BL_GRP_NO END AS BL_TAB_NM /* 심사BL그룹번호 */ FROM ( SELECT A.INPT_MST_SRNO, /* 심사마스터일련번호 */ A.INPT_TASK_ID, /* 심사테스크아이디 */ A.INPT_BL_GRP_NO, /* 심사BL그룹번호 */ ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.INPT_MST_SRNO, A.INPT_BL_GRP_NO ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(A.INPT_TASK_ID)) AS RN FROM CSPD002TG A /* 테스크테이블 */ WHERE A.INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} ) B WHERE RN = 1

/* selectSafeWtchRst */ SELECT A.INPT_MST_SRNO, A.INPT_BL_GRP_NO, A.BL_NO, A.FILT_DTCT_NO, ( SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '102' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD ) AS SW_NM, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(LST_DB_CHG_DTM,1,14), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS FILT_INPT_RST_RECP_DTM, CASE WHEN A.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO = B.MAX_AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SPD_KIND FROM CSPD007TL A, ( SELECT MAX(AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO) MAX_AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO FROM CSPD007TL WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} ) B WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO DESC, A.INPT_BL_GRP_NO

/* image page info */ SELECT A.INPT_MST_SRNO , A.INPT_BL_GRP_NO , A.IMEX_HIS_CD , A.INPT_TASK_ID , A.INPT_ELMT_ID , A.AI_INPT_PAPS_QLT_SCRE , B.ACTL_FX_REFNO , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.INPT_BL_GRP_NO, A.IMEX_HIS_CD ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(A.INPT_TASK_ID)) AS RN FROM CSPD002TG A JOIN CSPD001TM B ON B.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO WHERE A.INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno}

/* TotalText Result */ SELECT 'TOTAL' AS SPD_KIND , A.INPT_MST_SRNO , B.INPT_BL_GRP_NO , C.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS IMEX_HIS_NM , B.IMEX_HIS_CD , B.INPT_TASK_ID , A.AI_INPT_TOTALTEXT_SRNO , A.AI_INPT_SANCTION_RULE_TXT , NVL(A.AI_INPT_TOTALTEXT_RVSN_YN, 'N') AS AI_INPT_TOTALTEXT_RVSN_YN , NVL(A.BFRS_AICR_EXTC_TXT, 'N') AS BFRS_AICR_EXTC_TXT , A.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT FROM CSPD003TF A JOIN CSPD002TG B ON B.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND B.INPT_TASK_ID = A.INPT_TASK_ID JOIN CSPD112TI C ON C.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '100' AND C.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = B.IMEX_HIS_CD WHERE A.INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} ORDER BY CASE WHEN B.IMEX_HIS_CD = '01' THEN 1 WHEN B.IMEX_HIS_CD = '02' THEN 2 WHEN B.IMEX_HIS_CD = '03' THEN 3 WHEN B.IMEX_HIS_CD = '04' THEN 4 WHEN B.IMEX_HIS_CD = '05' THEN 5 WHEN B.IMEX_HIS_CD = '06' THEN 6 WHEN B.IMEX_HIS_CD = '07' THEN 7 WHEN B.IMEX_HIS_CD = '08' THEN 8 WHEN B.IMEX_HIS_CD = '09' THEN 9 WHEN B.IMEX_HIS_CD = '10' THEN 10 WHEN B.IMEX_HIS_CD = '11' THEN 11 WHEN B.IMEX_HIS_CD = '12' THEN 12 ELSE 99 END, TO_NUMBER(B.INPT_TASK_ID)

SELECT A.INPT_MST_SRNO, -- 마스터번호(확인용) A.ACTL_FX_REFNO, -- ref번호(확인용) NVL2(B.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT, 'EXT', 'CMN') AS ST_RST_KIND, -- 추출구분 A.INPT_BL_GRP_NO, -- 그룹번호 B.IMEX_HIS_CD, -- 항목코드 B.INPT_TASK_ID, -- 이미지아이디 A.AI_INPT_CMN_CD AS INPT_SANCTION_NO, -- 심사번호 A.INPT_SANCTION_NM, -- 심사명 TRIM(B.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT) AS INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT, -- 심사데이터 B.AI_INPT_SANCTION_RULE_TXT, -- 심사규칙 B.BFRS_TA_EXTC_TXT, -- TA전처리 B.AI_INPT_EXTC_SNTN_TXT, -- TA전처리후 B.AI_INPT_ALT_YN, -- 경고여부 B.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT, -- 수기입력 -- [수기추가 컬럼 기능] 동적 "수기 추가" 컬럼(최대 3개) 저장값. 없으면 NULL. B.ITM_INPT_HNDG_ADD1_TXT, B.ITM_INPT_HNDG_ADD2_TXT, B.ITM_INPT_HNDG_ADD3_TXT, A.AI_INPT_SORT_SEQ, -- 심사시퀀스 ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DAT) > 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM ( SELECT TRIM(SD.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT) AS DAT, COUNT(SD.INPT_SANCTION_NO) SANC_CNT FROM CSPD002TG SB, CSPD004TF SD WHERE SB.INPT_MST_SRNO = SD.INPT_MST_SRNO AND SB.INPT_TASK_ID = SD.INPT_TASK_ID AND SB.INPT_MST_SRNO = B.INPT_MST_SRNO AND SD.INPT_SANCTION_NO = B.INPT_SANCTION_NO AND SB.INPT_BL_GRP_NO = B.INPT_BL_GRP_NO AND TRIM(SD.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY TRIM(SD.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT) ) ) AS ITM_INPT_NACRD_YN, -- 불일치여부 ( SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT SB.IMEX_HIS_CD, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SB.IMEX_HIS_CD) AS IMEX_HIS_CD FROM CSPD001TM SA, CSPD002TG SB, CSPD004TF SD WHERE SA.INPT_MST_SRNO = SB.INPT_MST_SRNO AND SA.INPT_MST_SRNO = SD.INPT_MST_SRNO AND SB.INPT_TASK_ID = SD.INPT_TASK_ID AND SB.INPT_MST_SRNO = B.INPT_MST_SRNO AND SD.INPT_SANCTION_NO = B.INPT_SANCTION_NO AND SB.INPT_BL_GRP_NO = B.INPT_BL_GRP_NO AND TRIM(SD.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT) IS NOT NULL ) AS CONCAT_IMEX_HIS_CD -- 불일치코드그룹
FROM ( -- 업무구분별 항목 테이블 SELECT C.INPT_BL_GRP_NO, C.INPT_MST_SRNO, A.ACTL_FX_REFNO, B.AI_INPT_CMN_CD, B.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS INPT_SANCTION_NM, B.AI_INPT_SORT_SEQ FROM CSPD001TM A, CSPD112TI B, ( SELECT DISTINCT INPT_MST_SRNO, INPT_BL_GRP_NO FROM CSPD002TG WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} ) C WHERE A.INPT_MST_SRNO = C.INPT_MST_SRNO AND A.INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} AND B.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = DECODE(A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, '1', '240', '2', '230', '01', '240', '02', '230', '') ) A, ( SELECT TO_CHAR(B.INPT_MST_SRNO) INPT_MST_SRNO, A.ACTL_FX_REFNO, B.INPT_BL_GRP_NO, B.IMEX_HIS_CD, B.AI_INPT_PAPS_QLT_SCRE, B.INPT_TASK_ID, C.INPT_SANCTION_NO, DECODE(C.ITM_INPT_RVSN_YN, 'U', '', C.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT) AS INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT, C.AI_INPT_SANCTION_RULE_TXT, C.BFRS_TA_EXTC_TXT, C.AI_INPT_EXTC_SNTN_TXT, C.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT, -- [수기추가 컬럼 기능] C.ITM_INPT_HNDG_ADD1_TXT, C.ITM_INPT_HNDG_ADD2_TXT, C.ITM_INPT_HNDG_ADD3_TXT, C.AI_INPT_ALT_YN FROM CSPD001TM A, -- 마스터 테이블 CSPD002TG B, -- 이미지 테이블 CSPD004TF C -- 심사상세 테이블 WHERE B.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND C.INPT_MST_SRNO = B.INPT_MST_SRNO AND C.INPT_TASK_ID = B.INPT_TASK_ID AND A.INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} AND C.SAFEWATCH_ITM_YN = 'Y' ) B WHERE A.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = TO_CHAR(B.INPT_SANCTION_NO(+)) AND A.INPT_BL_GRP_NO = B.INPT_BL_GRP_NO(+) ORDER BY A.INPT_BL_GRP_NO, A.AI_INPT_SORT_SEQ

SELECT A.INPT_MST_SRNO, A.ACTL_FX_REFNO, A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AS AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD, A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD, A.AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD, A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, B.AI_INPT_APPV_SRNO, A.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD AS MST_TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD, A.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD AS MST_INPT_ITM_AI_INPT_RST_CD, A.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD AS SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD, A.QLT_GRN_AI_INPT_RST_CD AS MST_QLT_GRN_AI_INPT_RST_CD, A.AI_INPT_QLAS_PROS_CD, A.AI_INPT_IMG_KEY_NO, A.AI_INSPE_ENO, A.AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO, A.QLAS_CRPE_ENO, A.QLAS_SNPE_ENO, ( SELECT NVL2(MAX(AI_INPT_APPV_SRNO), 'Y', 'N') FROM CSPD005TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} AND AI_INPT_APPV_SRNO = B.AI_INPT_APPV_SRNO AND AI_INPT_APPV_STCD = '120' ) AS REBTN_YN, ( SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '170' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD ) AS TOTRST_NM, ( SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '170' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD ) AS ITMRST_NM, ( SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '170' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD ) AS SW_NM, ( SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '190' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.QLT_GRN_AI_INPT_RST_CD ) AS QARST_NM, ( SELECT MAX(FILT_DTCT_NO) KEEP( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY LST_DB_CHG_DTM DESC ) AS FILT_DTCT_NO FROM CSPD007TL WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO ) AS FILT_DTCT_NO, ( SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '150' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD ) AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM, ( SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '901' ) AS AI_INPT_PAPS_QLT_SCRE FROM CSPD001TM A, ( SELECT MAX(TO_NUMBER(AI_INPT_APPV_SRNO)) AS AI_INPT_APPV_SRNO FROM CSPD005TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} AND AI_INPT_TPY_SAVE_YN = 'N' ) B WHERE A.INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno}

SELECT A.AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO, B.AI_INPT_USER_NM AS AI_INPT_CRPE_NM, A.AI_INPT_PRC_OPI_TXT, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.AI_INPT_PRC_DTM,1,8), 'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS INPT_RCP_DT, ( SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '300' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.AI_INPT_APPV_STCD ) AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM FROM CSPD005TH A, CSPD101TI B WHERE B.AI_INPT_USER_ID = A.AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO AND A.INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} AND A.AI_INPT_APPV_STCD IS NOT NULL AND A.AI_INPT_APPV_STCD NOT IN ('50')
AND A.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD IN ('1', '2', '3')
AND A.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD IN ('1', '2')
ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_APPV_SRNO

SELECT A.AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO, B.AI_INPT_USER_NM AS AI_INPT_CRPE_NM, A.AI_INPT_PRC_OPI_TXT, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.AI_INPT_PRC_DTM,1,8), 'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS INPT_RCP_DT, ( SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '300' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.AI_INPT_APPV_STCD ) AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM FROM CSPD005TH A, CSPD101TI B WHERE A.AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO = B.AI_INPT_USER_ID AND A.INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} AND A.AI_INPT_TPY_SAVE_YN ='Y'
AND A.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD = '3'
AND A.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD IN ('1', '2')

SELECT A.INPT_MST_SRNO , A.INPT_SANCTION_NO , A.INPT_TASK_ID , CASE WHEN A.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT IS NOT NULL THEN A.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT ELSE A.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT END AS INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT FROM CSPD004TF A JOIN CSPD002TG B ON B.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND B.INPT_TASK_ID = A.INPT_TASK_ID WHERE A.INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno}
mapper.insert:
/* 그룹내 입력 Sanction번호 정보 미존재시, insert */ INSERT INTO CSPD004TF ( INPT_MST_SRNO ,INPT_TASK_ID ,INPT_SANCTION_NO ,SAFEWATCH_ITM_YN ,ITM_INPT_RVSN_YN ,ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT
,ITM_INPT_HNDG_ADD1_TXT ,ITM_INPT_HNDG_ADD2_TXT ,ITM_INPT_HNDG_ADD3_TXT ,AI_INPT_ALT_YN --AI심사ALERT여부(2.20) ,AI_INPT_SANCTION_RULE_TXT --AI심사SANCTION규칙내용(2.20) ,TRN_LOG_SRNO ,LST_DB_CHG_ID ,LST_DB_CHG_DTM ) VALUES ( #{inptMstSrno} ,#{inptTaskId} ,#{inptSanctionNo} ,'Y' --SafeWatch항목여부 ,'I' --Safewatch Insert ,UPPER(TRIM(#{itmInptHndgInpDatTxt})) ,UPPER(TRIM(#{itmInptHndgAdd1Txt})) ,UPPER(TRIM(#{itmInptHndgAdd2Txt})) ,UPPER(TRIM(#{itmInptHndgAdd3Txt})) ,#{aiInptAltYn} --AI심사ALERT여부 ,#{aiInptSanctionRuleTxt} --AI심사SANCTION규칙내용 ,#{trnLogSrno} ,#{lstDbChgId} , )
mapper.update: MERGE INTO CSPD005TH A USING DUAL ON ( A.INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} AND A.AI_INPT_APPV_SRNO = ( SELECT MAX(AI_INPT_APPV_SRNO) FROM CSPD005TH A WHERE A.INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} AND A.AI_INPT_TPY_SAVE_YN = 'Y' AND A.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD = #{aiInptBizDscd} ) ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO = #{aiInptCrpeEno}, A.AI_INPT_TOTALTEXT_RST_CD = #{mstTotaltextAiInptRstCd}, A.AI_INPT_ITM_RST_CD = #{mstInptItmAiInptRstCd}, A.AI_INPT_QLAS_PRC_STS_CD = #{mstQltGrnAiInptRstCd}, A.AI_INPT_PRC_OPI_TXT = #{aiInptPrcOpiTxt}, A.AI_INPT_APPV_STCD = #{aiInptAcvtStsCd}, A.AI_INPT_TPY_SAVE_YN = #{aiInptTpySaveYn}, A.AI_INPT_PRC_DTM = , A.TRN_LOG_SRNO = #{trnLogSrno}, A.LST_DB_CHG_ID = #{lstDbChgId}, A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM = WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( A.AI_INPT_APPV_SRNO, A.INPT_MST_SRNO, A.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD, A.AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO, A.AI_INPT_PRC_OPI_TXT, A.AI_INPT_TPY_SAVE_YN, A.AI_INPT_APPV_STCD, A.AI_INPT_TOTALTEXT_RST_CD, A.AI_INPT_ITM_RST_CD, A.AI_INPT_QLAS_PRC_STS_CD, A.AI_INPT_PRC_DTM, A.TRN_LOG_SRNO, A.LST_DB_CHG_ID, A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM ) VALUES ( CSPD005TH_SG01.NEXTVAL, #{inptMstSrno}, #{aiInptBizDscd}, #{aiInptCrpeEno}, #{aiInptPrcOpiTxt}, #{aiInptTpySaveYn}, #{aiInptAcvtStsCd}, #{mstTotaltextAiInptRstCd}, #{mstInptItmAiInptRstCd}, #{mstQltGrnAiInptRstCd}, (SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSFF6') FROM DUAL), #{trnLogSrno}, #{lstDbChgId}, )
UPDATE CSPD001TM SET PAPS_RE_SCAN_NED_YN = 'Y', TRN_LOG_SRNO = , LST_DB_CHG_ID = #{lstDbChgId}, LST_DB_CHG_DTM = WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno}
UPDATE CSPD001TM SET PAPS_CLF_ERR_YN = 'Y', LST_DB_CHG_DTM = WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno}
mapper.select: SELECT N.INPT_SANCTION_NO AS INPT_SANCTION_NO, Z.IMEX_HIS_CD, TO_NUMBER(N.INPT_TASK_ID) AS INPT_TASK_ID, W.AI_INPT_RMRK_TXT AS IMEX_HIS_ABBR, TRIM(N.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT) AS INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT, CASE WHEN N.ITM_INPT_RVSN_YN = 'U' THEN null ELSE N.SAFEWATCH_ITM_YN END AS SAFEWATCH_ITM_YN FROM CSPD004TF N, CSPD112TI W, CSPD002TG Z WHERE N.INPT_MST_SRNO = Z.INPT_MST_SRNO AND N.INPT_TASK_ID = Z.INPT_TASK_ID AND W.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '100' AND W.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = Z.IMEX_HIS_CD AND N.INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} AND Z.INPT_BL_GRP_NO = #{aiInptGrpCd} AND N.INPT_SANCTION_NO = #{inptSanctionNo} AND TRIM(N.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY W.AI_INPT_SORT_SEQ, TO_NUMBER(N.INPT_TASK_ID) ASC

SELECT * FROM CSPD004TF A , CSPD002TG B WHERE A.INPT_TASK_ID = B.INPT_TASK_ID AND A.INPT_MST_SRNO = B.INPT_MST_SRNO AND A.INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} AND (A.SAFEWATCH_ITM_YN = 'N' OR A.SAFEWATCH_ITM_YN IS NULL) AND TO_CHAR(A.INPT_SANCTION_NO) =(SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM = #{inptSanctionNm} AND AI_INPT_GRP_CD =200) AND B.INPT_BL_GRP_NO = #{inptBlGrpNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE CSPD004TF SET SAFEWATCH_ITM_YN = NULL WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} AND INPT_TASK_ID = #{inptTaskId}

UPDATE CSPD008TH SET LST_DB_CHG_ID = #{lstDbChgId},
AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = #{aiInptAcvtCd},
AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD = #{aiInptAcvtStsCd},
AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO = #{aiInptCrpeEno},
AI_INPT_PROS_STA_DTM = (SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSFF6') FROM DUAL),
TRN_LOG_SRNO = #{trnLogSrno}, LST_DB_CHG_DTM = (SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSFF6') FROM DUAL) WHERE AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO = (SELECT MAX(AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO) FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} )
UPDATE CSPD004TF SET INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT=#{inptSanctionDatTxt} WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} AND INPT_TASK_ID = #{inptTaskId} AND INPT_SANCTION_NO=#{inptSanctionNo}
mapper.select: SELECT QLT_GRN_AI_INPT_RST_CD FROM CSPD001TM WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno}
SELECT NACD FROM CSPD115TI WHERE ENG_NL_NM = UPPER(TRIM(#{itmInptHndgInpDatTxt}))
